description: IR1 is Akatsuki’s 1-μm camera, using separate 0.90-μm dayside and nightside filters and 0.97- and 1.01-μm filters to study Venusian clouds, near-surface water vapour and surface thermal emission.
short_description: Akatsuki IR1 1-μm Venus camera filters (0.90 day/night, 0.97, 1.01)
facility_description: Akatsuki, also called the Venus Climate Orbiter or PLANET-C, is JAXA’s Venus mission for studying the planet’s atmosphere using cameras at several wavelengths and radio occultation.
